top_jobs.job: When I brief an ad, a page or a product and cannot say who buys from us and why, help me see the real buyers and the job they hire us for, backed by orders, reviews and their own words, so money stops going to a customer we made up
top_jobs.metric: share of orders that map to a named avatar with evidence

top_jobs.job: When plenty of people visit and few buy, or returns climb, help me name the top reasons they hold back or send it back and what changed the mind of those who bought, so the page answers the doubt instead of shouting louder
top_jobs.metric: conversion rate on the top 5 product pages, and not as expected return rate

top_jobs.job: When I or the copywriter sit down to write, and when a new wave of reviews lands, help me use the exact words customers use and see what they love and hate as it changes, so the copy sounds like them and a quality slip does not hurt sales first
top_jobs.metric: share of live ads and pages that use a language bank phrase, and review rating trend

top_jobs.job: When I decide where to spend to win new buyers, help me see which buyer groups by age, gender, placement, first product and channel make the most gross profit over 6 months and which are getting pricier, so budget goes to buyers worth having
top_jobs.metric: 6 month gross profit per new customer, by buyer group

top_jobs.job: When a small group of customers makes a big share of our profit and some of them go quiet, help me know them by name, treat them quietly well and hear why any stop, so they stay and bring others
top_jobs.metric: 12 month repeat rate of the top 5 percent of customers

jobs.job: Map why customers hire the product: code 500 reviews, 200 tickets and all survey answers by the moment, the progress wanted, what they used before and what nearly stopped them, and rank the top 5 jobs by share
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.need: coding sheet: moment, progress, old way, doubt

steps: Pull the last 12 months of reviews, tickets and survey answers
Code each for the 4 parts: moment, progress wanted, old way, what nearly stopped them
Check 30 codes by hand and fix the coding rules
Group into jobs and count the share of each
Write each job as 1 line: when I, I want to, so I can, with 3 quotes
jobs.output: a ranked list of 5 customer jobs, each with share, 3 quotes and the old way
jobs.next: feeds 02-04 (avatars), 10 copy angles and 09 creative hooks

watch.metric: share of new ads built on a named customer job

jobs.drives: cost per new customer on job-led ads

jobs.job: Add a 3 question post-purchase survey: where did you first hear of us, what were you using before, what nearly stopped you
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then read weekly

inputs.from: Shopify app store, free or cheap tier

inputs.need: channel list for the first question

steps: Install the survey on the thank you page
Write the 3 questions with 6 choices and an other box
Check the answer rate after 1 week; aim for 20 percent or more
Each Monday, count answers by channel and by first product
Send new old-way and doubt answers to the customer jobs map
jobs.output: a live survey and a weekly count of answers by channel and product

watch.metric: survey answer rate

jobs.drives: better reads on what brings buyers

jobs.job: Book 8 customer calls in 2 weeks, split by first product and repeat vs one time buyers, with a $25 gift card, and add notes to the brain
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then 4 calls a month

inputs.need: list of recent buyers split by product and repeat

steps: Pick 30 buyers across 4 groups and send a short invite
Book 8 calls of 20 minutes
Ask about the moment before buying, the old way and what nearly stopped them
Write notes the same day with quotes marked verbatim
File notes on the customers shelf and tag the job and avatar
jobs.output: 8 call notes with verbatim quotes, filed and tagged

watch.metric: calls done per month

jobs.job: Draft up to 4 avatars with evidence: share of orders, first product, trigger to buy, doubts, words and where they spend time, each claim linked to a source, and have the founder sign them before any creative or page is chosen
jobs.trigger: once after 02-01, then re-signed each quarter

inputs.need: orders with first product and region
age and gender of buyers from ads

steps: Group buyers by job and first product and take the share of orders
Fill each avatar's 6 fields from the jobs map, quotes and ad breakdowns
Link each field to its source; mark guesses as guesses
Show the founder where data and belief disagree
Founder signs; file on the customers shelf and core page
jobs.output: up to 4 signed avatars, each with share of orders and sourced fields
jobs.next: feeds every brief on 09 creative, 10 copy and 07 landing pages

watch.metric: share of briefs that name a signed avatar

jobs.drives: fewer ads for a made up buyer

jobs.job: Split gift orders from self purchases, and write who buys and who uses for the gift season
jobs.trigger: once a year, 10 weeks before the main gift season

inputs.need: orders with gift notes, gift wrap or a different ship to name

steps: Flag gift orders from notes, wrap and ship to name
Compute gift share by month and by product
Read gift reviews for who gave and who got it
Write 2 lines: the giver's worry and the receiver's delight
Hand both to creative and email before the season
jobs.output: a gift share table and a giver and user note
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative and 14 email gift campaigns

watch.metric: gift season revenue against last year

jobs.job: Build the objection ladder: every doubt from reviews, tickets, chats and pre-sale questions, ranked by sales lost, with the answer, the proof and where the answer lives today
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then monthly

inputs.need: reviews that mention a doubt before buying

steps: Pull every doubt and group into themes
Rank themes by count and by the order value of the people who raised them
Write the best answer and the proof for each
Mark where it is answered: product page, FAQ, ad, email, or nowhere
Send the top 3 blanks to the page and copy teams
jobs.output: a ranked ladder of doubts with answer, proof and a coverage mark
jobs.next: feeds 07 landing pages, 10 copy and 04-13 (offer around the doubt)

watch.metric: conversion rate on pages where a top doubt was answered

jobs.job: Code not as expected returns into who the product is wrong for, and write a not for you if line for each product page
jobs.trigger: monthly
steps: Pull returns and low reviews for the top 10 SKUs
Code each by the mismatch: size, feel, use, expectation
Name the buyer each mismatch fits
Write a not for you if line per product
Put it on the page and track return rate for 60 days
jobs.output: a mismatch table per SKU and a not for you if line per page
jobs.next: feeds 07 product pages and 15 CX macros

watch.metric: not as expected return rate

jobs.job: Split every too expensive comment into cannot afford vs do not see the value, and pick the fix: proof and value for the second, a smaller pack or pay in parts for the first
jobs.trigger: quarterly, and when price complaints rise

inputs.need: reviews, chats and survey answers with price words
pack sizes and price per unit

steps: Pull every mention of price, cost, expensive, worth
Code each as cannot afford, no value seen, or price vs a named rival
Count each and check the price band
Pick the fix per group
Hand value fixes to copy and pack fixes to offers
jobs.output: a price objection split with counts and 1 fix per group

watch.metric: price mentions in chats per 100 sessions

jobs.job: Ask 300 visitors who leave the top product page without buying 1 question, what stopped you today, and add the answers to the objection ladder
jobs.trigger: once, run for 2 weeks, then each quarter
steps: Set an exit question on the top 2 product pages
Collect answers for 2 weeks
Code answers into the ladder themes
Compare what non-buyers say with what buyers said nearly stopped them
Update the ladder ranks
jobs.output: 300 coded exit answers and an updated ladder

watch.metric: answers collected per week

jobs.job: Build the language bank: the top 50 phrases customers use for the problem, the product and the result, with counts, and the words we use that they never do
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then monthly

inputs.need: reviews, tickets, call notes and survey answers
our live ads, pages and emails
phrase rules: verbatim only, forum quotes never as testimonials

steps: Pull phrases of 2 to 6 words from the customer corpus
Group by problem, product and result and count each
Pull our own phrases from ads and pages
List our words they never use
Hand the top 20 to copy with 1 source quote each
jobs.output: a language bank of 50 phrases with counts and a list of our words to drop
jobs.next: feeds 10 copy, 09 creative hooks and 17 SEO

watch.metric: share of new ads using a bank phrase

jobs.drives: click through and conversion on new copy

jobs.job: Split every live ad and top page into avatar and pain point, count spend and purchases for each pair, and list the pairs we never speak to
jobs.trigger: monthly, after the ad pull

inputs.need: ad copy with spend and purchases, 90 days

steps: Tag each ad and page with 1 avatar and 1 pain
Check 20 tags by hand and fix the rules
Sum spend, purchases and cost per purchase per pair
Mark pairs with good results and low spend, and pairs with no ads
Brief 3 ads for the best unspoken pair
jobs.output: an avatar by pain grid with spend, results and 3 briefs

watch.metric: cost per purchase for ads on new pairs

jobs.job: Send a weekly review pulse: themes customers love, hate and wish for, per product, with rating trend and any theme that doubled
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: new reviews with rating and product

steps: Pull last week's reviews
Tag each with themes and sentiment
Compare theme counts with the 8 week average
Flag themes that doubled and ratings down 0.2 or more
Send quality flags to ops and praise quotes to copy
jobs.output: a weekly pulse: love, hate, wish lists, rating trend and flags

watch.metric: average rating per top product

jobs.job: Alert the same day when complaints on 1 topic spike in comments, tickets or reviews, with the count, the first post and a draft reply
jobs.trigger: every day at noon and 5pm
steps: Count mentions per topic in the last 6 hours
Compare with the same hours over the last 4 weeks
Flag a topic at 3 times its usual count
Draft a reply and a fix owner
Send to the founder and support lead
jobs.output: a same day spike alert with a draft reply

watch.metric: hours from spike to first reply

jobs.drives: trust kept on a bad day

jobs.job: Build the best segment map: pull 90 days of Meta breakdowns by age, gender, placement and region, compute cost per new customer and purchase value per cell, and name the top 3 and bottom 3 cells
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every 2 weeks

inputs.need: breakdowns by age, gender, placement and region with spend and purchases
minimum spend per cell to trust

steps: Pull breakdowns for 90 days
Drop cells under the minimum spend
Compute cost per purchase and value per purchase per cell
Rank cells and name top 3 and bottom 3
Write who the top cell is in 1 line for the writer
jobs.output: a segment grid with top and bottom 3 cells and a 1 line brief
jobs.next: feeds 10 copy and 09 creative (tailor to the top cell) and 11 placements

watch.metric: cost per purchase in the top cell

jobs.job: Show 6 month gross profit per new customer by first product, channel, first code and region, not just first order value
jobs.trigger: monthly
steps: Group new customers by first order month and by each split
Sum gross profit per customer at 30, 90 and 180 days
Rank groups at 180 days
Mark groups with a small first order but high 180 day profit
Write the max cost per new customer each group can take
jobs.output: a buyer group table with 180 day gross profit and a max cost per new customer
jobs.next: feeds 11 paid social budget and 04-09 (loyal vs new offers)

watch.metric: 180 day gross profit per new customer

jobs.job: Track cost per new customer for each segment cell each quarter, and move budget from cells getting pricier to cells still cheap
jobs.trigger: quarterly, and when cost per new customer rises 2 months running

inputs.need: cost per new customer by month

steps: Compare each cell's cost this quarter with last quarter
Mark cells up 20 percent or more
Set each cell's cost against its 180 day value
Propose a budget shift and the ads that fit the cheaper cells
Founder approves the shift
jobs.output: a quarterly shift plan by cell with the value case

watch.metric: blended cost per new customer

jobs.job: Find a buyer group no rival speaks to: list every angle rivals run, map each to an avatar, name the group none serve, and test it with 3 ads
jobs.trigger: twice a year

inputs.need: reviews that mention uses and buyers we do not target

steps: Tag every rival ad with the avatar it speaks to
Count ads per avatar across all rivals
Find groups with buyers in our reviews and few or no rival ads
Brief 3 ads for the best one
Launch as 1 test and read cost per new customer
jobs.output: an avatar count across rivals, 1 unserved group and a launched test

watch.metric: cost per new customer in the unserved group test

jobs.job: Rank customers by 12 month gross profit and recency, pick the top 2 percent, and send each a personal letter with quiet early access, telling no one else
jobs.trigger: once, then each quarter

inputs.need: what we can offer quietly: early access, a private product

steps: Rank customers by 12 month gross profit, then by recency
Pick the top 2 percent and remove anyone with an open complaint
Write a short personal letter signed by the founder
Offer quiet early access to the next launch with a private link
Log who got what and track their next 90 days
jobs.output: a VIP list, letters sent and a log of what each did next

watch.metric: repeat rate of VIPs against a held back group

jobs.job: Show a new product or message idea to 20 VIPs before any ad spend and collect a yes, maybe or no with 1 reason each
jobs.trigger: before each launch or big message change

inputs.need: the idea as 1 image and 3 lines

steps: Pick 20 VIPs who fit the idea's avatar
Send the idea with 1 question and the form
Collect answers for 5 days
Count yes, maybe and no and group the reasons
Write go, change or stop
jobs.output: 20 answers with reasons and a go, change or stop call

watch.metric: share of launches tested on VIPs first

jobs.job: Ask good customers who went quiet why, in their own words: email the top customers overdue by 2 times their usual gap, and code the answers
jobs.trigger: monthly

inputs.need: customers with their usual gap between orders
an email tool to send a plain email

steps: List top 10 percent customers now 2 times past their usual gap
Send a plain email from the founder with 1 question
Code replies: product, price, rival, life change, service
Count reasons and name any rival they moved to
Send product and service fixes to the owners
jobs.output: a monthly list of leave reasons with counts and named rivals
jobs.next: feeds 15 CX, 03 competitors and 14 win back flows

watch.metric: reply rate and win back orders

new_enablers.name: Buyer groups over time
new_enablers.what: Groups buyers by first order month, first product, channel, first offer or code, region and avatar, then tracks repeat rate, orders and gross profit at 30, 90 and 180 days for each group.
powers: which groups are worth paying more to win
whether a loss making entry product pays back
